CTREND source intake review. We need a serious system for Bybit Spot Demo with a shared 500 USDT wallet. No Live, no leverage, and no financial backtest is being started in this round.
Primary study: Fieberg, Liedtke, Poddig, Walker, Zaremba, "A Trend Factor for the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns", JFQA DOI 10.1017/S0022109024000747. Full published PDF has been read. Official author-linked replication package: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/NTIVT8 . The official Harvard Dataverse v1.1 page was visibly inspected:68 files, CC0, named MATLAB source incl README,b01ReadData.m,b02CalculateIndicators.m,b05CreateCTREND.m,Utils/fEstCombinedLasso.m,b14Table9_CTRENDPortfoliosAndTransactionCosts.m.
Verified paper method:28 technical indicators transformed to cross-sectional ranks; next-week excess-return forecasts;52week rolling FM coefficients; combination via cap-weighted elastic net (mix0.5,correctedAIC); average forecasts retained by positive selection weights; weekly cap-weighted quintiles. Published standalone long high-quintile H exists, as well as H-minus-L factor. One-day lag and12week validation are robustness alternatives, not baseline. Published Table9 long H cost examples30/40/50bps are historical article figures, NOT our measured profit or Bybit proof. Paper mentions extreme1%return trimming and423weeks with sample endpoints needing reconciliation.
Critical evidence boundary: source file CONTENTS have NOT been retrieved. Bulk Download reached a browser error page; browser URL policy disallowed interacting with chrome-error protocol, so stopped. Separate native read-only official file API requests for README and b05 each returned bare HTTP403. No code was executed. Access failure proves no source defect. No attempts to bypass controls.
Two internal Codex researchers agree original code needed to verify time indices, where return trimming enters test returns/membership, exact turnover/drift/initial-final costs, point-in-time universe, and500USDT minimum orders/rounding. Do not infer a blanket OHLCV ban from prior exact rejected configurations; CTREND semantic difference is provisional until actual code/behavior compared. Original BTC/ETH frozen future study remains untouched. Prior label-collapse config is terminal under its own comparator, no retuning.
Give a short adversarial decision on (1) whether long H can be considered an original published leg rather than inventing a no-short system; (2) which source-code checks are essential before Demo, distinguishing actual defects from unknowns; (3) whether any price reads/backtest or Demo admission is justified now; (4) minimal safe next action while code download is unavailable. Do not invent inspected code, new performance, missing code, universal OHLCV impossibility, or an arbitrary trade-count gate.

۱) آیا long H یک پای منتشرشده اصلی است؟
 بله، مشروط. مقاله بهصراحت از quintile portfolio و long high-quintile (H) صحبت میکند و آن را بهعنوان بخشی از تحلیل اصلی گزارش کرده است، نه صرفاً یک افزونه بدون پشتوانه. Leg long-only H در ادبیات این مقاله وجود دارد. اما این به معنای «سیستم کامل long/cash با مدیریت ریسک و خروج» نیست؛ مقاله یک factor portfolio آکادمیک است، نه یک استراتژی معاملاتی با stop/exit فیزیکی و sizing روی ۵۰۰ USDT. بنابراین long H بهعنوان «پای منتشرشده» قابل استناد است، اما «سیستم کامل» نیست و نباید بهعنوان چنین چیزی برچسب بخورد.
۲) بررسیهای ضروری کد قبل از Demo:
 (الف) شاخص زمانی: آیا سیگنال در close هفته 
t
 محاسبه و در open هفته 
t+1
 اجرا میشود؟ (ب) محل trimming ۱٪: آیا روی بازده آزمون اعمال میشود یا بازده آموزش، و آیا membership را تحت تأثیر قرار میدهد؟ (ج) گردش مالی: نحوه محاسبه drift وزنها و هزینه اولیه/نهایی. (د) universe point-in-time: آیا coinهای delisted حذف شدهاند یا survivorship bias وجود دارد؟ (ه) حداقل سفارش ۵۰۰ USDT و rounding در برابر quintile cap-weighted. اینها 
unknown
 هستند تا زمانی که کد دیده شود؛ «نقص» نیستند.
۳) آیا خواندن قیمت/بکتست یا Demo اکنون موجه است؟
 خیر. بدون تأیید کد، هر بکتستی صرفاً بازتولید فرضیات ناشناخته است. Demo admission نیز بدون عبور از قرارداد کامل (ورود/خروج/sizing/cash) موجه نیست. قیمتهای محافظتشده نیز ممنوع.
۴) حداقل اقدام امن بعدی:
 درخواست دسترسی به فایلهای README و b05 از طریق کانال مجاز (مثلاً درخواست مستقیم از نویسنده یا Dataverse API با روشهای مجاز)، بدون دور زدن 403. تا آن زمان، CTREND در وضعیت 
research intake only
 باقی میماند. هیچ ادعای سودآوری، دسترسی به کد، یا تأیید Demo ندارم.
14 web pages

Keep source intake blocked on artifact receipt; no financial backtest or Demo admission. Access failures are not model defects or a blanket OHLCV ban. Original H is an explicitly published long leg; weekly reconstitution is a logical exit. A physical stop is not a universal requirement for a complete portfolio rule. Our cash/execution/risk contract and Bybit500USDT sizing remain unverified, and additions would be adaptations. Correct the phrase minimum order500USDT:500USDT is wallet capital; venue minimum order/quantity/rounding are unknown here. Printed paper long cost inputs30/40/50bps map to nominal60/80/100bps symmetric roundtrip, whereas project30/50/80 map to15/25/40bps per side. This unit reconciliation is not a new measured return. Required source:README,setup,b01ReadData,b02CalculateIndicators,b05CreateCTREND,fEstCombinedLasso,b14Table9 and direct filtering/ranking/regression/portfolio helper dependencies. Need causal training/target indices, trimming location, PIT membership/delistings, drift and initial/final costs, and exact weights/minimum-order feasibility. No retries/proxies/security-control bypass, no author contact, no reopening terminal hypotheses, no protected future data reads.
